We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template from make_5_lvl2-template_search-1 to the given molecule. We have mapped_rxn and template_id 29646. Need to apply that template retrosynthetically to target molecule (initial_molecule). Use apply_template with target SMILES and template_id. Then format list of lists of precursor SMILES combos.

First get target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have template_id 29646. Use apply_template.
